release_notes: Recover Manhole rows missed when whole-page token OCR sees only part of a ruled B&C table
Automatically retry Manhole OCR when the parsed count differs from the user-confirmed expected count
Use slower alternate row, crop, padding, and OCR segmentation passes only after a count mismatch
Keep count recovery conservative: only PDF-observed IDs are accepted and rows are never fabricated or trimmed just to hit the count
